xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5298: Flaky e2e: issue-tree.spec.ts 'Herdr-spawned reviewer' / 'pane inventory' tests time out on main CI (2 occurrences today)

plan.title: Flaky e2e: issue-tree.spec.ts 'Herdr-spawned reviewer' / 'pane inventory' tests time out on main CI (2 occurrences today)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: tests/e2e/issue-tree.spec.ts failed on main CI test-shard 4/4 in runs 43609143655 and 43629012750 on commits that change no code. All four attempts per run (2 tests x retry 1) waited out the full 20 s poll for the Details tab ([data-testid="drawer-tab-overview"], lines 315/337), and test 2 loaded its page in about 4 s, so the Vite server stayed unusable rather than slow. In both runs styleguide-conformance and merge-train ran concurrently in the same shard. All e2e harnesses share Vite's default optimizer cache (src/dashboard/frontend/node_modules/.vite), and each optimizer commit replaces its deps/ folder; locally three harnesses committed to it five times in seven seconds. merge-train and styleguide-conformance also fail their dependency scan because they lack the pdfjs-dist-assets alias, so they re-optimize during page loads (504 Outdated Optimize Dep). Local probes could not make the issue-tree server fail from another server's commit, and the harness logs nothing about what the page received, so the CI failures left no evidence.
narratives.Proposal: Add tests/e2e/fixtures/vite-harness.ts with createViteCacheDir/removeViteCacheDir (a private mkdtemp cacheDir under .cache/vite-e2e/, deleted in afterAll), pdfjsAssetsAlias, and createRecordingLogger (a Vite customLogger that records info+ lines and still prints errors). All four harnesses use a private cacheDir and the alias. issue-tree records failed requests, page errors and the Vite log, and throws them in its failure message when the Details tab does not appear; it also closes contexts in finally. Update docs/TESTING.md and the codebase conventions map. Record falsifiable evidence: a DEBUG=vite:deps isolation check that fails pre-fix, 20 issue-tree runs, and a before/after contention loop.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Moving the browser specs into a serial lane or out of the default shards (PAN-4733)
- Un-quarantining tests/e2e/linked-conversation-title-bar.spec.ts or editing scripts/flaky-quarantine.txt (PAN-4733)
- Raising renderPoll, test, hook or page.goto timeouts, or changing Vitest retry
- Changing any expect(...) assertion or matcher in the four specs
- Changing any frontend component under src/dashboard/frontend/src
- Deduplicating the harnesses' other copied boot code (package resolution, ensureFrontendNodeModules, mock transport plugin)
- Adding the diagnostic failure message to merge-train, styleguide-conformance or linked-conversation-title-bar
- A changelog.d entry (test-infrastructure-only change)
- Claiming in docs or the PR that the shared cache is the proven root cause

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the shared optimizer cache and missing alias across all four e2e harnesses, not only issue-tree.
autoDecisions.rationale: The shared mutation is proven and symmetric: isolating only issue-tree would leave merge-train and styleguide-conformance committing into each other's deps folder.

autoDecisions.summary: Use a unique mkdtemp cacheDir per run under <projectRoot>/.cache/vite-e2e/ rather than a stable per-spec folder.
autoDecisions.rationale: A stable folder collides when two Vitest runs share one checkout; .cache/ is gitignored and inside Vite's default fs.allow, which a planning probe verified.

autoDecisions.summary: Add a diagnostic failure message to issue-tree instead of raising timeouts.
autoDecisions.rationale: Local probes did not reproduce the failure, and the CI logs hold no evidence; a self-describing failure lets a follow-up fix the true cause, while longer timeouts would mask it.

autoDecisions.summary: Record before/after evidence under CPU contention (taskset -c 0-3) in addition to the issue's 20-run loop.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue-tree-alone loop passes on the unfixed tree locally, so it cannot falsify the fix; the isolation check and contention loop can.

items.title: Add tests/e2e/fixtures/vite-harness.ts with cache-dir, alias and recording-logger helpers plus a unit test

narrative.Action: Create tests/e2e/fixtures/vite-harness.ts exactly as PRD WI-1 shows. createViteCacheDir(projectRoot, label) makes <projectRoot>/.cache/vite-e2e/ recursively and returns mkdtemp(join(parent, `${label}-`)). removeViteCacheDir(dir) runs rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }) and no-ops on undefined. pdfjsAssetsAlias(resolvePackage) returns { find: 'pdfjs-dist-assets', replacement: dirname(realpathSync(resolvePackage('pdfjs-dist/package.json'))) }. createRecordingLogger(createLogger, lines) builds base = createLogger('error'), forwards every method (info, warn, warnOnce, error, clearScreen, hasErrorLogged) to base, and pushes 'info  <msg>', 'warn  <msg>', 'error <msg>' into lines, recording each warnOnce message only once. It exposes hasWarned through a getter and setter on base, writes the returned object member by member, and never spreads base. Create tests/unit/e2e-fixtures/vite-harness.test.ts with the four tests the PRD names, using a stub createLogger whose vi.fn() warn/warnOnce/error set base.hasWarned = true (vite does not resolve from the root suite) and an os.tmpdir() mkdtemp project root cleaned in afterEach. Read no source file in either file.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-3. Add a module-level const viteLog: string[] = []. In beforeAll, take createLogger from the same dynamic import(vitePath) as createServer, and replace logLevel: 'error' with logLevel: 'info', customLogger: createRecordingLogger(createLogger, viteLog). openCockpit() registers page.on('response') (status >= 400) and page.on('requestfailed') listeners into a failures array before page.goto, and returns it. Add waitForDetailsTab(page, failures, pageErrors) exactly as the PRD shows: it polls the Details tab count with renderPoll and on failure throws an Error whose message joins 'The Stage issue view never rendered its Details tab.', 'Failed requests (N):', 'Page errors (N):' and 'Vite log, last 40 lines (N):' sections, with { cause: error }. Both tests call it instead of the first poll, then keep the locator click and all later assertions unchanged. Implementation checkpoint: temporarily break the selector locally to confirm the message, restore it, and commit nothing from that check; if Vitest hides the message with cause set, drop cause and append String(error) as a last section.
